Economy · India

Two Banks Report Profit Increases in Q1 Financial Results

City Union Bank announced a 25% increase in its net profit for the first quarter, reaching ₹383 crore. Separately, IDFC First Bank reported its net profit more than doubled to ₹1,075 crore in the same quarter, leading to a 9% surge in its stock price. These financial results reflect the performance of these banking institutions during the specified period.
